description: Pluggable editorial and artifact linter built on a zero-dependency Node.js micro-kernel across Markdown, HTML/CSS/JSX/SVG, Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx), PDF, and raster images.
rules: Run deterministic local checks first with `npx --yes dislop check <path> --no-llm --format agent` (or `dislop check <path> --format agent`).
Apply verified safe deterministic cleanups with `npx --yes dislop fix <path> --auto --backup` or review hunks interactively with `dislop fix <path>`.
Verify edited drafts against git HEAD with `npx --yes dislop verify --git HEAD <file>` so no numbers, units, URLs, code spans, or proper nouns are dropped or reversed.
For Remote MCP without local setup, connect to `https://dislop.com/mcp`, or start the local stdio server with `npx --yes dislop-mcp`.
Use pure-Markdown Agent Skills via `npx --yes skills add dislop-ai/dislop --skill dislop` (or task-focused `deslop-docs`, `deslop-slides-docx`, `deslop-web-ui`, `deslop-verify`).
